title: Validate Binary Search Tree
inputFormat:
Implement isValidBST(root). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Trees use level-order arrays with null for missing children. The editor passes nodes with val, left, and right properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: Return true if the entire tree satisfies strict binary search tree ordering; otherwise return false.

visuals.title: Check every ancestor, not just the parent
